title: Double Rotations
mission: Name the case, then rotate twice
briefing: Some strain cannot be fixed with one rotation. When the heavy child leans the OTHER way you face an LR or RL case: first rotate at the child to straighten the path, then rotate at the strained room. Name the case before you touch anything - a wrong name jolts the alarm.
hints: Left-heavy room whose left child leans right = LR. Right-heavy room whose right child leans left = RL.
Step 1 rotates at the CHILD, step 2 rotates at the strained room itself.
